notable.name: Trinidadian Hindustani
notable.note: spoken by descendants of Indian indentured laborers brought 1845–1917; Indo-Trinidadians are roughly a third of the population

terrainDescription.zh: 特立尼達島北部山脈覆蓋熱帶雨林，鄰近委內瑞拉外海，多貝哥島地形較平緩，西部走廊（西班牙港至聖費爾南多）人口與都市化程度高。
terrainDescription.en: Trinidad's Northern Range holds tropical rainforest just off the Venezuelan coast, Tobago is gentler terrain, and the west-coast corridor (Port of Spain to San Fernando) is densely populated and urbanized.

historicalContext.zh: 前英國殖民地，靠左行駛，官方語言為英語，日常口語常見千里達/多貝哥克里奧語；1845年後大量印度契約勞工移入，形成人口比例顯著的印裔千里達社群，部分地區仍可見印地語相關文化痕跡。
historicalContext.en: A former British colony that drives on the left; English is official, with Trinidadian/Tobagonian Creole common in everyday speech. Large-scale Indian indentured migration after 1845 produced a substantial Indo-Trinidadian community, leaving Hindustani-linked cultural traces in parts of the country.
